summary: AcademiaOS Phase 3 (AI use cases catalog + Content Studio + AI Instructor + AI Advisor + Student Assistant) — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. All 16 backend pytest tests passing (100%) including real LLM calls to Claude Sonnet 4.6 / GPT-4o via Emergent universal key. All major UI flows verified end-to-end with real LLM responses, RTL toggle, multi-tenant override.

Tenant override correctly persists: PATCH /ai/use-cases/{isb}/ai_instructor with openai/gpt-4o is reflected in subsequent GETs and audit log captures the change with action='ai.use_case.update'.
AI Instructor session continuity verified — second message reuses session_id; sessions endpoint returns 4+ messages after two turns.
Cross-tenant scoping is correctly enforced (ISB admin → EAIC use-cases returns 403).

Real LLM latency observed: Claude Sonnet 4.6 first call ~10s, subsequent ~3-5s. Advisor generate_json returns well-structured payload with summary/top_priorities/recommended_path/career_pathway/proactive_alerts.
